in_sanskrit.name: Perin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus Flower
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Perin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Perin is derived from the Tamil word 'perundu' meaning 'lotus flower'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus flower symbolizes purity, creation, and enlightenment. It is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom.
